page: Amazon Web Services c8ib.96xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System. Powered by Intel x86_64 processors running at 3.9 GHz, the server provides 192 physical cores and 384 dedicated vCPUs with two threads per core. System memory is configured at 768.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio typical of compute-focused architectures.

The instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 400 Gbps, supporting significant multi-node throughput for inter-node communication and data ingestion. Local storage is not included on the system, requiring reliance on external networked storage for disk operations. It does not incorporate hardware accelerators or GPUs, concentrating all resources on central processor execution.

The platform offers high resource density for parallel compute tasks, maximizing processing capability relative to infrastructure footprint. Tradeoffs include the lack of integrated local NVMe storage and modest memory allocation per thread. This configuration is suitable for distributed high-performance computing, large-scale batch processing, financial simulations, and parallel build pipelines.
